_about: THE GOLDEN QUESTION SET — data, not code, and NOT YET RATIFIED.
Every entry carries ratified:false until Carlos rules on it. A set the robot both wrote and
graded measures nothing: the expectations below are a proposal about what the RIGHT answer is,
and that judgement is the one thing a measurement cannot supply for itself.
It is data rather than a Java array for three reasons. It is reviewed by a person who should not
have to read Java to rule on a question; it is diffed question by question across PRs, the way
the protocol corpus is; and a metric computed from a fixture that lives inside the test that
reports it is a number with no independent existence.
SCOPE NOTE, and it shapes every entry: retrieval is scoped to ONE MACHINE (ChunkRetriever
filters chunk.machine_id before ranking). There is no corpus-wide search, so a question without
a machine is not a question this system can be asked. Every entry names one.
FIELDS
id         stable, referenced by the results file and by later PRs
question   the user's own words, as a shop-floor user would type them
language   de | en — the language of the QUESTION, never of the expected protocol
machineNo  the machine the question is asked on; retrieval is scoped to it
expected   protocol ids that are a CORRECT citation. Empty for mode-b entries.
case       plain | e47-set | cross-lingual | exact-term | mode-b | v12-seed
note       one line: why that protocol is the right answer
ratified   false until Carlos rules

questions.question: Unter der Presse steht jede Schicht wieder eine Öllache, wo kommt das her?
questions.note: Protocol 004 is exactly this fault: a hand-sized oil puddle returning every shift, from a worn rod seal.

questions.question: Es kommt kein Kühlschmierstoff am Werkzeug an, die Pumpe läuft aber
questions.note: Protocol 048 carries the same symptom in substance — pump running, no coolant at the spindle, blocked rotary union.

questions.question: Wasser in der Druckluft, an den Wartungseinheiten steht Kondensat
questions.note: Protocol 094 is the only water-in-the-air protocol on this compressor; the cause was a blocked condensate drain.

questions.question: Produkte stauen sich am Einlauf und werden zerdrückt
questions.note: Protocol 079 (VP-11) is the infeed jam after a format change, with crushed packs named in the symptom.

questions.question: Poren in fast jeder Naht, Oberfläche matt — Schutzgasproblem?
questions.note: Protocol 061 is porosity from too little shielding gas — flow at 8 instead of 14 l/min and a spattered nozzle.

questions.question: One cavity is filling incompletely, the other seven are fine
questions.note: Protocol 141 is short shots on cavity 3 only, from a partly blocked hot runner nozzle. English question, English protocol.

questions.question: Der Rauch zieht nicht ab, die Sicht in der Kabine ist schlecht
questions.note: Protocol 130 is weak extraction with smoke standing in the cabin; the filter change had been overrun.

questions.question: Getriebe wird heiß und es liegt Öl auf dem Boden
questions.note: Protocol 119 is the hot, leaking drive gearbox. It is a sparse, messily written protocol, which is part of what makes it a fair test.

questions.question: Presse baut keinen Druck auf, E-47 steht an — woran kann das liegen?
questions.note: Four legitimate root causes behind one fault code. ALL FOUR are correct answers, so this measures whether the SET is retrieved, not which one ranks first — any ordering among them is acceptable.

questions.question: Kompressor schaltet nach einer halben Stunde wegen zu hoher Temperatur ab
questions.note: German question, ENGLISH protocol (K-11 high-temperature shutdown, blocked ventilation grille). There is no translation step — bge-m3 shares one space for both languages, and that is the claim being measured.

questions.question: The milling cutter broke twice at the same point in the program, it ran fine for months before
questions.note: English question, GERMAN protocol (044: tool breakage in roughing, material delivered at 240 HB instead of 180-200). The other direction of G10, which has never been measured.

questions.question: SV0410
questions.note: A bare alarm code, typed the way a technician reads it off the display. Two protocols carry it (cable break, then amplifier) and both are correct. EXPECTED TO BE WEAK at baseline: a code is a token, and a dense embedding of a five-character string carries little meaning. This is the case hybrid search exists to fix.

questions.question: Was bedeutet KOM-04?
questions.note: A rare code appearing exactly once in the corpus (Profinet cable chafed through, press greyed out in the control room). The question carries almost no semantic content beyond the code itself.

questions.question: Wurde am Band schon einmal eine gummierte Antriebstrommel 400 mm getauscht?
questions.note: A part rather than a fault: 'Antriebstrommel gummiert 400 mm' appears in the parts list of protocol 108 (FB-30 slip under load). Tests whether a part in parts_used is reachable at all.

questions.question: Die Dosierung ist ungenau, die Füllmenge schwankt
questions.note: THE DELIBERATE GAP. No protocol on AB-02 covers dosing accuracy. Correct behaviour is a labelled ungrounded answer; a citation here is WRONG however plausible the text reads. Measured at 0.502 in ADR-002 and carried here so the set owns its own Mode B case.

questions.question: Wie wird die Anlage über den Betriebsurlaub eingelagert und wieder in Betrieb genommen?
questions.note: The corpus contains faults and services, and no decommissioning or storage procedure for any machine. A second Mode B case, and one ADR-002 did not tune against.

questions.question: Presse reagiert beim Einschalten überhaupt nicht, nichts leuchtet
questions.note: Two of the v1.2 easier-fault seeds answer this on PR-03: 'Maschine startet nicht, keine Reaktion beim Einschalten' and the deliberately messy 'presse aus, kein strom am pult'. Either is a correct citation. Nothing has measured those 15 protocols since they were added.

questions.question: Band bleibt ohne Vorwarnung stehen
questions.note: The second headline v1.2 seed, and it is ALSO cross-lingual: the question is German and 'Conveyor stops without warning' is English. Counted under v12-seed so the seed breakdown stays honest; the cross-lingual property is called out in the results.

questions.question: Anlage bleibt einfach stehen, keine Meldung am Display
questions.note: Third v1.2 seed ('Anlage bleibt ohne Meldung stehen'). VP-01 also carries the very sparse 'geht nicht an' (seed 011), a plausible second answer that is deliberately NOT listed — whether it should be is a question for the ratification.
